effectEntries.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, this move will hit with double power.
effectEntries.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Pokémon in the air.

effectEntries.shortEffect: Inflige des dégâts réguliers et peut frapper les Pokémon dans les airs.

effectEntries.effect: Does not hit Pokémon under the effects of Fly.
Ne touche pas les Pokémon sous les effets de Vol.
